title: Three reflex replays versus re-planning the same maintenance commands

steps.command: gf_macro task-run "format lint and test billing package before release"

arguments.instruction: format lint and test billing package before release

steps.expect: N=3. Baseline each round is the instruction plus both shell commands plus their full stdout. Reflex each round is one gf_macro tools/call plus the dehydrated result.

baseline.note: Not a whole-file read. tokens_baseline sums N copies of instruction + planned commands + full command output.
